description: Per-coin fair value measurement of Canton Coin at the 2026-01-15 DTCC contract signing date, for use as noncash consideration in the referencing ASC 606 milestone package. Illustrative data.

measurements.valuationTechnique: Market approach. Fair value (exit price) estimated from informal OTC secondary-market quotes and self-reported trades for identical units, absent any active exchange market. The protocol fee-reference price is rejected as a fair value input because it is an administratively set fee-conversion parameter, not an arm's-length exit price. No marketability discount applied given no lock-up on the coin itself (the restriction in the referencing package is on when coin is earned, not on transfer once minted).

unobservableInputs.name: selectedExitPricePerCoin
unobservableInputs.basis: Midpoint/median of the two self-reported settled OTC trades (0.0032 and 0.0033 USD/CC) within a 0.0030-0.0038 quoted range. Self-reported and thin, hence Level 3 and confidence-adjusted.

measurements.notes: Selected FV 0.0033 USD/CC is ~6.6x the 0.0005 USD/CC fee-reference price, evidencing that the fee-reference price is not representative of market value.
